Hand-eye-marked.

The hand-eyes are calculated using multiple robotic position positions with the coordinates of the panel camera detected at the same time. Eye-to-Hand or Eye-in-Hand Change.SDK The process is independent of the camera web page: the program begins with reading the robotic library, choosing the robotic model and writing down its positional expression rules, and then starts collecting and calculating.

Full process

  1. Call the robotics library interface to obtain the number of axes, rotational expression, Euratom sequence, angle unit and bit field order for all brands, models and each model.

  2. Select how to install with the robotic model and write the camera through the configuration interface. Three-end repository Example Default to select the first model of the first brand.

  3. Move the robot to a new posture, waiting for the robot and the plate to stabilize.

  4. Call the plate position interface; read and enter the robotic position at that moment as soon as the test is successful.

  5. Keep both positions as the same sampling point and repeat multiple positions and positions.

  6. (a) Submit all pairing points to calculate hand-eye changes;3/4 Axe robots need to be inputted according to the process. offset and boardPosition.

  7. After a successful calculation, the precision of the hand-eye results can be continued; robotic precision checks can be performed independently of two points.

The robot configuration is a prerequisite for calculation.

The computation interface will be saved according to the camera currently. RobotParams Interpretation robotPose. This does not require users to operate the camera web page first; the caller should pass first SDK The libraries and configuration interfaces of the robots can be initialized. They cannot be submitted to the bit positions and leave out the robotic configuration.
